import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3

from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts, put_contact
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh(autocommit=False):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=None if autocommit else "")
    initialize(c)
    return c


def raises_value_error(fn, *args):
    try:
        fn(*args)
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError from %r" % (fn,))


def test_basic_insert_and_normalize():
    c = fresh()
    result = import_contacts(c, [
        {"email": " Alice@Example.COM ", "name": " Alice "},
        {"email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Bob"},
    ])
    assert result == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}, result
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("alice@example.com", "Alice"), ("bob@example.com", "Bob")]


def test_update_counts_even_when_name_unchanged():
    c = fresh()
    put_contact(c, "a@b", "Alice")
    c.commit()
    result = import_contacts(c, [
        {"email": "A@B", "name": "Alice"},
        {"email": "c@d", "name": "Carol"},
    ])
    assert result == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, result
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")]

    # Second import updates the name.
    result = import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b", "name": "Alicia"}])
    assert result == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1}, result
    assert ("a@b", "Alicia") in list_contacts(c)


def test_empty_batch():
    c = fresh()
    put_contact(c, "a@b", "Alice")
    c.commit()
    assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice")]


def test_rejects_bad_rows():
    c = fresh()
    bad_batches = [
        [None],
        ["a@b"],
        [["a@b", "A"]],
        [{}],
        [{"email": "a@b"}],
        [{"name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
        [{"email": 1, "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": 1}],
        [{"email": None, "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "   ", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "ab", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@@b", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "@b", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a b@c", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b\tc", "name": "A"}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": ""}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": "   "}],
        [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}, {"email": "A@B ", "name": "B"}],
    ]
    for batch in bad_batches:
        raises_value_error(import_contacts, c, batch)
        assert list_contacts(c) == [], batch
    raises_value_error(import_contacts, c, None)
    raises_value_error(import_contacts, c, 42)


def test_validation_failure_leaves_contacts_unchanged():
    c = fresh()
    put_contact(c, "keep@x", "Keep")
    c.commit()
    raises_value_error(import_contacts, c, [
        {"email": "new@x", "name": "New"},
        {"email": "broken", "name": "Broken"},
    ])
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("keep@x", "Keep")]


def _add_failing_trigger(c):
    c.execute(
        "CREATE TRIGGER fail_boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts "
        "WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END"
    )
    c.commit()


def test_database_failure_is_atomic_default_mode():
    c = fresh()
    put_contact(c, "keep@x", "Keep")
    c.commit()
    _add_failing_trigger(c)
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [
            {"email": "one@x", "name": "One"},
            {"email": "boom@x", "name": "Boom"},
            {"email": "two@x", "name": "Two"},
        ])
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected IntegrityError")
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("keep@x", "Keep")]
    # Connection still usable afterwards.
    assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "ok@x", "name": "Ok"}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}


def test_database_failure_is_atomic_autocommit_mode():
    c = fresh(autocommit=True)
    put_contact(c, "keep@x", "Keep")
    _add_failing_trigger(c)
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [
            {"email": "one@x", "name": "One"},
            {"email": "boom@x", "name": "Boom"},
        ])
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected IntegrityError")
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("keep@x", "Keep")]


def test_api():
    c = fresh()
    assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [
        {"email": "A@B", "name": "Alice"},
        {"email": "c@d", "name": "Carol"},
    ]}) == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")]

    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, None)
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, [])
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, {})
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, {"contacts": "x"})
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, {"contacts": {}})
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1})
    raises_value_error(handle_import, c, {"contacts": [{"email": "bad", "name": "x"}]})
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")]

    # Existing API still works.
    assert handle_add(c, {"email": "e@f", "name": "Eve"}) == {"ok": True}
    assert ("e@f", "Eve") in list_contacts(c)
    add_contact(c, "g@h", "Gus")
    assert ("g@h", "Gus") in list_contacts(c)
